verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a Public API and a local REST API via `bw serve`, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found all common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt file, markdown doc mirrors, CLI and MCP server are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
